deliverables: Custodial wallet onboarding with self-custody export
Organizer dashboard and ticket lifecycle tools
Independent third-party smart-contract audit with remediation report
Public launch campaign and three trade-show activations
Public metrics dashboard and quarterly reporting
Revenue-share repayment mechanism to the Cardano Treasury
request.recipient: Anvil Development Agency, Inc. / Intersect as budget administrator
request.what: Fund Phase 2 of a production Cardano-native ticketing platform operated by Sellout.io and built by Anvil Development Agency, including a secondary marketplace, on-chain royalty enforcement, anti-scalping controls, wallet onboarding, organizer tools, security audit, and launch campaign.

claims.claim: Phase 1 is already live on Cardano mainnet with on-chain event creation, CIP-68 ticket minting, transfers, and attendance verification funded by Sellout with over $130,000.
The proposal requests 4,969,231 ada, stated as about $1,093,231 at $0.22 per ADA, including a 3% Intersect administration fee over 8 months.
Phase 2 will deliver a secondary marketplace, royalty enforcement, anti-scalping controls, wallet onboarding, organizer tools, an independent audit, and launch amplification.
Sellout has more than 200,000 registered users, has issued more than 250,000 tickets, and currently supports more than 350 events annually.
The Yellowstone Club 2026 concert series is presented as a contracted anchor deployment projected to move more than $6 million through Cardano in year one.
The team commits to repay $1,093,231 to the Cardano Treasury through a revenue-share mechanism using 25% of fees until full reimbursement and 5% afterward.
Milestone-gated disbursement, contingency return, independent audit, oversight review, quarterly reporting, and contractual revenue-share repayment are presented as treasury protections.
The proposal targets 200+ events on-chain, 75,000+ CIP-68 NFT tickets, 150,000+ on-chain interactions, $6 million+ ticket revenue on-chain, and 20,000+ new wallets within 12 months of launch.
On-chain metrics are said to be independently verifiable through Cardano explorer data and policy-ID tracking, with a public metrics dashboard planned for M5.
The requested withdrawal is asserted not to breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the moment of submission.

summary: The document requests 4,969,231 ada for an 8-month Phase 2 buildout of a Cardano-native ticketing platform, with milestone-gated administration through Intersect/TRSC-PSSC, claimed existing Sellout traction, projected on-chain adoption, and a proposed treasury repayment structure.
